newsitem.title: JAPAN: Asahi says Super Dry may be top-selling Japan beer.
newsitem.headline: Asahi says Super Dry may be top-selling Japan beer.

text.p: Asahi Breweries Ltd said on Wednesday that shipments of its mainstay Super Dry beer in the January-June period totaled 955,200 kilolitres, up 20 percent from the same period a year ago.
A spokesman for Asahi said Super Dry had likely been the best-selling brand in Japan, replacing Kirin Brewery Co Ltd's Kirin Lager.
A Kirin spokesman said the company plans to announce total shipments of Kirin Lager in the first half of 1997 on July 11.
Kirin Lager has been the best-selling brand in Japan on an annual basis since 1954, he said.
